decisions.reason: Its move from a website mention in 2023 to the home page in 2024 suggests performance at or above aspiration, and the firm's expansion gives enough slack to retain this closely related service.

Being featured on the home page in both 2023 and 2024 indicates consistently satisfactory results relative to aspiration, so management has little reason to search for an alternative use of these resources.

The retail shop gained prominence from a simple mention to home-page placement, which signals improving acceptance, and the firm's slack and sheltered-workshop fit support continuation despite possible modest margins.

As a 2024 launch that is only mentioned on the website, its results are still more uncertain and may be closer to aspiration, but the firm's hiring and expansion make it likely to give this adjacent service more time rather than drop it immediately.
